Hide-and-seek on the street needs your precise location during the round. And once when you open the city rating: to find your city, and only its name goes to the server.

Who sees it: the game server. Seekers see each other; hiders only when the rules reveal them: out of the zone, inside a building, no signal. If the host opens the game, spectators with an account see everybody a little later, and admins live. After the round, the game’s players see everybody’s way on the map.

When it is deleted: every game is recorded, everybody’s way is kept for 90 days and only the game’s players with an account see it; your way goes with your account. «Save my routes» in your profile keeps your own routes 90 days too, only for you. Nothing is kept on your phone.

While you play, the app writes everything: where you are, what happens with the phone and the game, whom Bluetooth hears, and the app’s crashes and errors. It is kept for 90 days on the test server, and only the developers see it. With an account it is deleted with the account; a guest’s goes after the 90 days, or sooner if you ask the test’s organizers. You can withdraw the consent on the start screen or in the profile.
This test build can’t be played without the log. Install the regular version when it comes out.
